routine.title: Lower — Reduced
routine.notes: Use instead of a full lower session when the day also contains substantial football. Maintenance stimulus, not a second hard leg session. Keep around 2-3 reps in reserve.

exercises.notes: Two working sets only. Use a comfortable load for 5-7 clean reps.
Two controlled working sets. Hamstrings loaded, no grinding.
Straight-knee calf maintenance, reps each side.
